chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid Shabab al-Sayrafi, from Muawiya ibn Ammar al-Duhni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Seventy Prophets are buried in what is between the Yamani Corner and the Black Stone. Allah caused them to die of hunger and adversity.

key_terms.الرُّكْنِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: The Yamani Corner of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: How many prophets are buried between the Yamani Corner and the Black Stone?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the space between the Yamani Corner and the Black Stone as a sacred burial ground for seventy prophets, emphasizing their martyrdom through hunger and hardship. This tradition underscores the Kaaba's deep historical roots in prophetic history, linking the physical site of Hajj to the spiritual legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt's forebears. The mention of 'hunger and hardship' highlights the ascetic nature of many prophets, resonating with Shia themes of patience (sabr) in the face of worldly trials.
